heading: Development Authority Reviews Zoning Code Changes
summary: The authority discussed a zoning code update in open session. Staff walked members through proposed changes and then turned to accessible parking. The parking discussion drew on examples from an earlier meeting.

heading: Wisconsin Announces Multistate Meta Settlement
summary: Wisconsin DOJ announced a multistate settlement with Meta worth up to $17.1 billion. The agency said up to $313 million could go to Wisconsin. The agreement also calls for changes to child safety features on Instagram and Facebook.
